12320-civilization-and-beyond-learning-f.title: Civilization And Beyond Learning From History
12320-civilization-and-beyond-learning-f.creator: Scott Nearing
12320-civilization-and-beyond-learning-f.description: A book by Scott Nearing. "Assyria, Greece, Rome, Carthage, where are they?" asked Byron. He might have added: "What were they? How did they come into being? What was the nature of their experience? Why did they rise from small beginnings, develop into wide-spread colossal complexes of wealth and power, and then, after longer or shorter periods of existence, break up and disappear from the stage of social history?"

arxiv-2106-01357.title: Diffusion Schrödinger Bridge with Applications to Score-Based Generative Modeling
arxiv-2106-01357.creator: Valentin De Bortoli, James Thornton, Jeremy Heng, Arnaud Doucet
arxiv-2106-01357.description: Abstract Progressively applying Gaussian noise transforms complex data distributions to approximately Gaussian. Reversing this dynamic defines a generative model. When the forward noising process is given by a Stochastic Differential Equation (SDE), Song et al., 2021 demonstrate how the time inhomogeneous drift of the associated reverse-time SDE may be estimated using score-matching.

arxiv-2205-08088.title: Linear Sigma Dark Matter
arxiv-2205-08088.creator: Dan Kondo, Robert McGehee, Tom Melia, and Hitoshi Murayama
arxiv-2205-08088.description: Abstract We present a model of self-interacting dark matter based on QCD-like theories and inspired by the proximity of a 0 ​ ( 980 ± 20 ) a_{0}(980\pm 20) to the K ​ K ¯ ​ ( 990 ) K\bar{K}(990) threshold.

arxiv-2208-09882.title: General coefficient-vanishing results associated with theta series
arxiv-2208-09882.creator: Shane Chern, Dazhao Tang
arxiv-2208-09882.description: Abstract . There are a number of sporadic coefficient-vanishing results associated with theta series, which suggest certain underlying patterns. By expanding theta powers as linear combinations of products of theta functions, we present two strategies that will provide a unified treatment.

arxiv-2312-00830.title: Asymmetric Duffing oscillator: the birth and build-up of period doubling
arxiv-2312-00830.creator: Jan Kyzioł, Andrzej Okniński
arxiv-2312-00830.description: Abstract In this work, we investigate the period doubling phenomenon in the periodically forced asymmetric Duffing oscillator. We use the known steady-state asymptotic solution – the amplitude-frequency implicit function – and known criterion for the existence of period doubling. Working in the framework of differential properties of implicit functions we derive analytical formulas for the birth of period-doubled solutions.

arxiv-2312-15241.title: Measuring Value Alignment
arxiv-2312-15241.creator: Fazl Barez, Philip Torr
arxiv-2312-15241.description: Abstract As artificial intelligence (AI) systems become increasingly integrated into various domains, ensuring that they align with human values becomes critical. This paper introduces a novel formalism to quantify the alignment between AI systems and human values, using Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) as the foundational model.

arxiv-2404-04076.title: Neutrinos as possible probes for quantum gravity
arxiv-2404-04076.creator: M.D.C. Torri a∗, L.Miramonti a
arxiv-2404-04076.description: Abstract In this paper, we aim to explore the interplay between neutrinos and quantum gravity, illustrating some proposals about the use of these particles as probes for the supposed quantized structure of spacetime. The residual signatures of a more fundamental theory of quantum gravity can manifest themselves modifying the free particle dispersion relations and the connected velocity.

arxiv-2406-04261.title: Simulating, Fast and Slow: Learning Policies for Black-Box Optimization Thanks: Qualcomm AI Research is an initiative of Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.
arxiv-2406-04261.creator: Tim Bakker, Fabio Valerio Massoli, Thomas Hehn, Tribhuvanesh Orekondy, Arash Behboodi
arxiv-2406-04261.description: Abstract Simulators are vital in science and engineering, as they faithfully model the influence of design parameters on real-world observations. Optimizing design parameters to minimize a desired objective function is notoriously challenging since simulators are often non-differentiable black boxes. Moreover, each simulation incurs significant compute time, thus doing such optimizations naively may be prohibitively expensive.

arxiv-2407-15147.title: Industry Dynamics with Cartels: The Case of the Container Shipping Industry Thanks: suguru.otani@e.u-tokyo.ac.jp , Market Design Center, University of Tokyo I thank my advisor Jeremy Fox for valuable advice. I also thank my committee members, Yunmi Kong, Maura Coughlin, and Arun Gopalakrishnan. I am
arxiv-2407-15147.creator: Suguru Otani
arxiv-2407-15147.description: Abstract This paper studies how shipping conferences—explicit cartels—shaped container shipping through prices, entry, and investment from 1973–1990. I estimate a structural model to disentangle static pricing and internal allocation effects from dynamic entry and investment responses. Estimated price wedges equal 30–70% of mean observed freight rates, and conference rents encouraged entry and shipbuilding.

arxiv-2407-18621.title: Twenty-three New Heartbeat Star Systems Discovered Based on TESS Data
arxiv-2407-18621.creator: Min-Yu Li, Sheng-Bang Qian, Ai-Ying Zhou, Li-Ying Zhu, Wen-Ping Liao, Er-Gang Zhao, Xiang-Dong Shi, Fu-Xing Li, Qi-Bin Sun
arxiv-2407-18621.description: Abstract Heartbeat stars (HBSs) are ideal astrophysical laboratories to study the formation and evolution of binary stars in eccentric orbits and the internal structural changes of their components under strong tidal action. We discover 23 new HBSs based on TESS photometric data.

arxiv-2409-01580.title: Foreactor: Exploiting Storage I/O Parallelism with Explicit Speculation
arxiv-2409-01580.creator: Guanzhou Hu, Andrea C. Arpaci-Dusseau, Remzi H. Arpaci-Dusseau
arxiv-2409-01580.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Guanzhou Hu, Andrea C. Arpaci-Dusseau, Remzi H. Arpaci-Dusseau. We introduce explicit speculation , a variant of I/O speculation technique where I/O system calls can be parallelized under the guidance of explicit application code knowledge. We propose a formal abstraction – the foreaction graph – which describes the exact pattern of I/O system calls in an application function as well as any necessary computation associated to produce their argument values.

arxiv-2412-20853.title: Incentive-compatible Collusion-resistance via Posted Prices
arxiv-2412-20853.creator: Mathues V.X. Ferreira, Yotam Gafni, Max Resnick
arxiv-2412-20853.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Mathues V.X. Ferreira, Yotam Gafni, Max Resnick. We consider a refinement to the notions of collusion-resistance in transaction fee mechanisms. In particular, we require that the collusion is by itself incentive-compatible and individually rational to all of its participants. We then study the structural properties of these notions, and importantly, characterize the class of collusion-resistant and incentive-compatible transaction fee mechanisms in the single bidder case, and show that this is exactly the class of posted-price where the price is not too prohibitive.

arxiv-2503-01514.title: A Generalized Fréchet Test for Object Data with Unequal Repeated Measurements
arxiv-2503-01514.creator: Jingru Zhang, Shengjie Zhang, Christopher W Jones, Mathias Basner, Haochang Shou
arxiv-2503-01514.description: Abstract Advancements in data collection have led to increasingly common repeated observations with complex structures in biomedical studies. Treating these observations as random objects, rather than summarizing features as vectors, avoids feature extraction and better reflects the data’s nature. Examples include repeatedly measured activity intensity distributions in physical activity analysis and brain networks in neuroimaging.

arxiv-2506-10225.title: Fine-Grained control over Music Generation with Activation Steering † Equal contribution. All authors are affiliated with the Indian Institute of Technology Madras. Correspondence to: Jayden Koshy Joe (jaydenkjoe@gmail.com)
arxiv-2506-10225.creator: Dipanshu Panda † , Jayden Koshy Joe † , Harshith M R † , Swathi Narashiman, Pranay Mathur, Anish Veerakumar, Aniruddh Krishna, Keerthiharan A
arxiv-2506-10225.description: Abstract We present a method for fine-grained control over music generation through inference-time interventions on an autoregressive generative music transformer called MusicGen. Our approach enables timbre transfer, style transfer, and genre fusion by steering the residual stream using weights of linear probes trained on it, or by steering the attention layer activations in a similar manner.

arxiv-2510-09532.description: Abstract In this study, we evaluate multi-configurational trial wave function protocols for phaseless auxiliary field quantum Monte Carlo (ph-AFQMC) on transition metal containing systems. First, we benchmark vertical ionization potentials for 22 3 ​ d 3d transition metal complexes against published high-accuracy ph-AFQMC values in a double zeta basis set.

arxiv-2512-22201.title: Emergent Persuasion: Will LLMs Persuade Without Being Prompted?
arxiv-2512-22201.creator: Vincent Chang, Thee Ho, Sunishchal Dev, Kevin Zhu, Shi Feng, Kellin Pelrine, Matthew Kowal
arxiv-2512-22201.description: Abstract With the wide-scale adoption of conversational AI systems, AI are now able to exert unprecedented influence on human opinion and beliefs. Recent work has shown that many Large Language Models (LLMs) comply with requests to persuade users into harmful beliefs or actions when prompted and that model persuasiveness increases with model scale.

pmc-12593756.creator: Tingting Lv, Qing Liu, Yifei Wang, Ping Zhang
pmc-12593756.description: Climate change poses a significant threat to cardiovascular health through the combined effects of extreme temperatures, air pollution, and extreme weather events. Short-term heat exposure raises mortality risk by 3.80%, while long-term exposure to particulate matter (PM2.5, with an aerodynamic diameter of ≤2.5 micrometers) increases cardiovascular mortality by 11–20%.
